title: Once Upon a Time
goals: memahami struktur **narrative text**: Orientation, Complication, Resolution
memakai [[while]] dan [[when]] untuk menggabungkan dua kejadian
memakai kata cerita: [[once upon a time]], [[one day]], [[suddenly]], [[finally]]
membaca cerita pendek dan menemukan masalah serta penyelesaiannya

lesson.text: Kamu pasti suka **cerita**: dongeng, legenda, dan fabel. Di **Unit 1 Kelas 9** kamu belajar membaca dan menulis **narrative text** (teks naratif), lalu mengenal tense baru untuk menceritakan kejadian yang **sedang berlangsung** di masa lalu: **past continuous**.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur narrative text
table: [[Once upon a time, there was a clever mouse deer named Kancil.]]
[[One day, Kancil wanted to cross a river, but many crocodiles were waiting.]]
[[Kancil tricked the crocodiles and crossed the river.]]
[[Be smart and calm when you face danger.]]

lesson.title: Jenis narrative text
lesson.text: Fabel (cerita hewan), legenda (asal-usul tempat), dongeng (*fairy tale*), dan cerita pendek (*short story*) semuanya narrative text. Biasanya memakai **simple past** untuk kejadian utama dan **past continuous** untuk latar kejadian.

items.ex: Once upon a time, there was a king.
One day, a boy found a coin.
The greedy man wanted more gold.
The moral of the story is to be honest.

lesson.title: 3. Past continuous: rumus
lesson.text: Rumus: **was / were + kata kerja-ing**. Dipakai untuk kejadian yang **sedang berlangsung** pada suatu waktu di masa lalu.

examples.en: Negatif: [[She wasn't sleeping.]] / [[We weren't watching TV.]]
Pertanyaan: [[Were you studying?]] — [[Yes, I was.]] / [[No, I wasn't.]]

lesson.title: 4. While dan when
lesson.text: Past continuous sering dipakai bersama **simple past**. Past continuous untuk kejadian **yang sedang berlangsung** (latar), simple past untuk kejadian **yang memotongnya**.
table: [[While I was walking home, it started to rain.]]
[[I was walking home when it started to rain.]]
[[While Mom was cooking, I was doing my homework.]]

lesson.title: Cara mengingat
lesson.text: Bayangkan film: kegiatan yang **lama dan sedang berjalan** adalah **past continuous** (was walking). Kejadian **singkat yang memotong** adalah **simple past** (started to rain).

lines.en: Once upon a time, there was a clever mouse deer named Kancil. He lived in a forest near a big river.
lines.id: Pada suatu waktu ada seekor kancil yang cerdik. Dia tinggal di hutan dekat sungai besar.

lines.en: One day, Kancil wanted to eat the fruit on the other side of the river. But many crocodiles were swimming in the water, and they were waiting for their dinner.
lines.id: Suatu hari Kancil ingin memakan buah di seberang sungai. Tapi banyak buaya berenang di air dan menunggu makan malam mereka.

lines.en: Kancil said, "I'm counting you for the King's party. Please line up!" The greedy crocodiles lined up from one side of the river to the other.
lines.id: Kancil berkata, "Aku menghitung kalian untuk pesta Raja. Tolong berbaris!" Buaya-buaya serakah itu berbaris dari satu sisi ke sisi lain.

lines.en: While the crocodiles were waiting, Kancil jumped on their backs and counted, "One, two, three..." Finally, he reached the other side and ran away happily.
lines.id: Saat buaya menunggu, Kancil melompat di punggung mereka sambil menghitung. Akhirnya dia sampai di seberang dan berlari dengan gembira.

lines.en: The moral: be smart and calm when you face danger.
lines.id: Pesan moral: bersikaplah cerdas dan tenang saat menghadapi bahaya.
